JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Combat Extended
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Combat Extended replaces combat with ballistics: calibres, penetration armour, cover, suppression and an ammo and bulk inventory.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Every gun needs its ammo; guns made or spawned by other mods arrive without any.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: JB mods look up a gun's ammo through the framework's CE adapter (default ammo of its ammo set).

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Yayo's Combat 3 (Continued)
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Yayo's Combat 3: a lighter combat overhaul with ammo, armour and accuracy changes.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Simple sidearms
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Pawns carry extra weapons as sidearms and switch on their own between melee and ranged.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates: pirate factions, curses and buildable warcaskets.
